answer: In Proof of Agent, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing prevents Sybil attacks via topological cut verifications across the trust graph. When an adversary attempts to forge fraudulent identities to siphon rewards, honest verifiers isolate every suspicious vertex within an audited cut. Colluding nodes suffer stake slashing that incinerates their bonded capital, reducing identity creation to an ember. Because cut capacity requirements scale with cluster density, maintaining dishonest clusters imposes a superlinear attacker cost.
